comment: 第几天

text: 咖啡馆的私语
你替艾德里安和塞西莉亚在咖啡馆后座留了位置。
两人说了很久的话。离开时，塞西莉亚的脸上有一点笑意。
让让他们独处
你替朱利安制造了一个和塞西莉亚独处的下午。
他讲了些得体的笑话，塞西莉亚礼貌地听着。
改革派沙龙
你把艾德里安带进了改革派的沙龙。
他听得很认真，末了问了一句让全场安静下来的话。
伯爵的关系
你替朱利安搭上了伯爵的门路。
一个月后，他谋到了一个体面的职位。
咖啡馆的午后
塞西莉亚坐在窗边，用勺子搅着已经凉掉的咖啡。她说：「你说，人是不是只能过一种人生。」
「你可以选别人没走过的那条。」
「回去吧，别让你父亲担心。」
「时代要变了，你我都看得见。」
私定终生
塞西莉亚摘下颈上那枚旧坠子，塞进艾德里安手里。
「等春天，我们就走。」
咖啡馆的灯影在窗上晃了一下，谁也没有再说话。
门当户对
朱利安跪在塞西莉亚面前，捧出家族的戒指。
「我会给你一个体面的家。」
塞西莉亚看了很久，最后点了点头。
三人的对峙
咖啡馆打烊了，只剩下三个人和一盏灯。
「你凭什么？」朱利安说。艾德里安没有回答。
塞西莉亚站在中间，谁也没有看。
同志
艾德里安把一本小册子推到朱利安面前。
朱利安读了一夜。天亮时他说：「你说得对。」
冤狱
塞西莉亚被指控窝藏禁书，押进了圣西尔万的黑牢。
老伯爵在门外站了很久，最终没有进去。
捞人
你动用了积攒多年的关系。
三天后，塞西莉亚从牢里走了出来，瘦了一圈。
第一次顶撞
「我不嫁。」塞西莉亚说。
老伯爵把茶杯顿在桌上，没有再说一个字。
第二次顶撞
「你从来只想着你那个姓氏！」
这一次，塞西莉亚摔门而出。
沉默的餐桌
父女二人隔着一张长桌吃饭，全程没有人开口。
私奔
没有婚礼，没有嫁妆。两个人趁着夜色出了城门。
塞西莉亚回头看了一眼，老伯爵的宅邸没有一盏灯是亮的。
家族的出走
恐怖统治的前夜，瓦尔蒙一家收拾了细软，连夜离开了奥尔狄亚。
塞西莉亚什么也没带走，除了一把旧提琴。
圣西尔万堡垒
起义的旗帜插上了圣西尔万堡垒的残垣。
艾德里安倒在城墙下，手里还攥着那枚旧坠子。
多年以后，人们把这一天写进了教科书。
多年以后
多年以后，邻国的音乐厅里，一位女提琴手正在演奏一首无人听过的曲子。
有人问她这首曲子叫什么。她说：「《奥尔狄亚的春天》。」

text: 阿黛尔
comment: 第一天咖啡馆引入演出

text:
亲爱的孩子：

当你读到这封信时，我大概已经不能再亲手给你煮1111111111111111111杯咖啡了。请不要为此责怪自己。你走过的路、做过的决定，都值得被好好珍惜。

我把圣诺特的沸点咖啡馆留给你。钥匙和交接的手续已经安排妥当，那里会是你新的起点。它不算大，却收留过许多疲惫的人，也藏着我们还没来得及一起度过的日子。

我一直盼着与你重逢，听你说说这些年去了哪里，又变成了什么样的人。没能等到这一天，是我最放不下的遗憾。

愿你在忙碌时也记得吃饭，在难过时也有人陪伴。经营一家咖啡馆之前，先照顾好自己。不必成为我，只要成为你自己。

如果有一天，你听见门铃响起，就替我对推门而来的人说一声：欢迎。

而这一次，是我想对你说——欢迎回家。

text: 他微微颔首，便转身离开了咖啡馆。
comment: A-1013.s2-P132; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我望着他的背影，不由得想起了上次的交谈。
comment: A-1013.s2-P135; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 马尚先生似乎格外关心这家咖啡馆的经营状况。不过，他究竟是出于兴趣，还是另有打算，我暂时还说不清楚。
comment: A-1013.s2-P136; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 直到傍晚，最后一位客人才终于离开。
comment: A-1013.s2-P141; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我关上店门，长长地舒了一口气。
comment: A-1013.s2-P142; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 大厅里还留着淡淡的咖啡香气，桌上的杯碟已经收拾妥当，只有柜台后那一叠尚未整理的账目，还在提醒着我今天有多么忙碌。
comment: A-1013.s2-P143; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 呼……今天可真是忙坏了。
comment: A-1013.s2-P145; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 辛苦了，阿黛尔。多亏有你帮忙，今天才能这么顺利。
comment: A-1013.s2-P146; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 是吗，感觉店长可比我辛苦多啦！不过，看到这么多客人能重新回来，我觉得再忙一点也没关系！
comment: A-1013.s2-P147; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 嗯，希望如此吧，可以一直保持这种状态。
comment: A-1013.s2-P148; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 一定会的！只要我们继续做好工作，大家一定会把沸点咖啡馆的名字记在心里的。
comment: A-1013.s2-P149; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我望着重新归于宁静的大厅，一丝丝成就感油然而生。
comment: A-1013.s2-P150; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 接手咖啡馆以来，事情并不总是顺利。然而，经过这些日子的奔波，这家店总算重新有了生气。
comment: A-1013.s2-P151; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 比起做了什么了不起的大事，能让客人抱怀期待地走进来，再心满意足地离开，我想对于一个经营者来说就已经是相当值得高兴的事情了。
comment: A-1013.s2-P152; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 只是可惜，这家咖啡馆似乎并没我想象得那般简单。
comment: A-1013.s2-P153; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 午后的咖啡馆比清晨安静了许多。
comment: A-1018.s1-P003; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 自从前些日子举办了促销活动，店里的生意已经有了明显起色。一些久违的熟客重新光顾，也有不少生面孔慕名而来。
comment: A-1018.s1-P004; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 虽然还谈不上门庭若市，但比起刚接手时的冷清，如今的光景已经令人欣慰了。
comment: A-1018.s1-P005; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 这时，一位穿着灰褐色外套、挎着旧皮包的先生走进店里。他环顾四周，选了一张靠窗的桌子坐下，随后取出一本小笔记簿放在桌边。
comment: A-1018.s1-P007; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 下午好。劳烦给我来杯咖啡。
comment: A-1018.s1-P009; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 好的，先生。请稍等。
comment: A-1018.s1-P010; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我回到柜台前，开始准备咖啡。
comment: A-1018.s1-P011; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 不多时，我将冲煮好的咖啡端到了客人面前。
comment: A-1018.s1-P014; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 先生，您的咖啡。请慢用。
comment: A-1018.s1-P015; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 他轻轻点头，端起杯子尝了一口。
comment: A-1018.s1-P016; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 嗯，味道不错。香气很足，入口也十分适口。看来您对咖啡的调配颇有心得。
comment: A-1018.s1-P018; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 多谢夸奖。能让您满意就好。
comment: A-1018.s1-P019; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 唔……味道稍微浓了些，不过倒也还好。
comment: A-1018.s1-P021; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 多谢您的意见。看来还有需要改进的地方。
comment: A-1018.s1-P022; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 说起来，这家店最近是不是换了主人？
comment: A-1018.s1-P023; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 是的。我不久前才从叔叔手中接过咖啡馆。
comment: A-1018.s1-P024; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 原来如此。以前听说过这家店，只是前阵子似乎遇上了些麻烦。如今看来，生意倒是渐渐恢复了。
comment: A-1018.s1-P025; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 确实经历了一些波折。不过好在事情已经解决了，前几天举办的促销活动也很顺利。
comment: A-1018.s1-P026; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 哦？那倒是件值得高兴的事。
comment: A-1018.s1-P027; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 他望向窗外。街上的行人来来往往，几位商贩正忙着收拾摊位。
comment: A-1018.s1-P028; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 这年头，王都每天都有新鲜事。今天这家店开张，明天那家店关门，想要安安稳稳地做些买卖，也不是那么容易啊。
comment: A-1018.s1-P029; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 是啊。接手咖啡馆以后，我才渐渐体会到经营一间店铺的不易。
comment: A-1018.s1-P030; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 哈哈，看来您已经有了不少心得。
comment: A-1018.s1-P031; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 他说着，翻开桌边的笔记簿，随手记下了几行文字。
comment: A-1018.s1-P032; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 先生似乎很喜欢记录这些事情？
comment: A-1018.s1-P033; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 算是职业习惯吧。每天在王都四处走动，见到些有意思的人和事，总免不了记下来。
comment: A-1018.s1-P034; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 这么说来，先生莫非是从事新闻工作的？
comment: A-1018.s1-P035; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 哦，还没向您介绍。我是《圣诺特之声》的记者，平日负责些市井新闻和社会见闻。
comment: A-1018.s1-P036; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 《圣诺特之声》？那可是全国都很有名的报纸。
comment: A-1018.s1-P037; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 哈哈，报纸确实有些名气，不过我也只是个普通撰稿人罢了。每天跑街串巷，找些值得写的题材，便是我的工作。
comment: A-1018.s1-P038; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 说起来，像您这样刚接手一家老店，又把生意重新做起来的年轻经营者，倒也值得写上几笔。
comment: A-1018.s1-P039; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我最近正打算写几篇关于王都街巷生活的短文。若是您不介意，我倒想把这家咖啡馆介绍给读者们。
comment: A-1018.s1-P042; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 您的意思是，要在《圣诺特之声》上介绍我们的咖啡馆？
comment: A-1018.s1-P043; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 正是如此。今天的咖啡不错，您的经历也很有意思。一家老店重新恢复了生气，这样的故事想必也会有人愿意读。
comment: A-1018.s1-P044; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 那真是太感谢您了。不知道需要准备些什么？
comment: A-1018.s1-P045; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 不必太麻烦。只要容我再问几个问题，核实一下店铺的情况就好。
comment: A-1018.s1-P046; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 接下来的片刻，他询问了咖啡馆的历史、叔叔过去经营的情况，以及我今后的打算。
comment: A-1018.s1-P047; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我尽可能如实作答。他一边听着，一边在笔记簿上写写停停，偶尔还抬起头来确认一些细节。
comment: A-1018.s1-P048; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 嗯，这样就差不多了。
comment: A-1018.s1-P049; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 请问，这篇文章需要支付什么费用吗？
comment: A-1018.s1-P050; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 哈哈，您误会了。这是我自己打算写的文章，并非商业广告，自然不必向您收费。
comment: A-1018.s1-P051; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 况且，能找到值得介绍的地方，对我们这些靠笔杆子吃饭的人来说，也算是件好事。
comment: A-1018.s1-P052; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 那就再次感谢您了。
comment: A-1018.s1-P053; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 不必客气。文章能不能让更多人喜欢这家店，最终还得看您今后的经营。
comment: A-1018.s1-P054; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 说起来，您既然刚刚接手咖啡馆，想必也希望让更多人知道这里吧？
comment: A-1018.s1-P058; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 当然。虽说最近的生意有所好转，但要重新积累客源，恐怕还得花上一些工夫。
comment: A-1018.s1-P059; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 那么，不知道您有没有考虑过在报纸上刊登广告？
comment: A-1018.s1-P060; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 报纸上的广告？
comment: A-1018.s1-P061; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 不错。《圣诺特之声》除了日常新闻，也承接各种商业广告。商铺开张、货物出售、剧院演出，只要内容合适，都可以付费刊登。
comment: A-1018.s1-P062; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 像您的咖啡馆，就可以在商业版面上介绍一下店铺的位置、咖啡的特色，以及营业时间。
comment: A-1018.s1-P063; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 听起来倒是个不错的办法。只是费用方面……
comment: A-1018.s1-P064; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 这得看刊登的篇幅和位置。如果只是简短的店铺介绍，价格倒也不算太高。
comment: A-1018.s1-P065; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 他从皮包里取出一张印有报社收费标准的纸页，递到我面前。
comment: A-1018.s1-P066; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我接过来看了看，又在心里盘算了一番。
comment: A-1018.s1-P067; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 需要宣传
comment: A-1018.s1-P069; 选项标签/结构; text staging only, event disabled

text: 嗯，这个价钱还可以接受。如果方便的话，我想为咖啡馆刊登一则广告。
comment: A-1018.s1-P070; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 当然可以。您只需要提供店铺的基本信息，以及希望在广告中介绍的内容即可。
comment: A-1018.s1-P071; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 那么，就请您帮忙安排吧。
comment: A-1018.s1-P072; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 好的。我会将您的委托带回报社，具体的排版和刊登日期，再由报社方面确认。
comment: A-1018.s1-P073; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 他认真记下了店铺的地址与名称，又询问了几项细节。
comment: A-1018.s1-P074; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 这样就可以了。若是一切顺利，过几天您就能在报纸上看到自己的店名了。
comment: A-1018.s1-P075; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 那就有劳您了。
comment: A-1018.s1-P076; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 不需要宣传
comment: A-1018.s1-P078; 选项标签/结构; text staging only, event disabled

text: 看过报价以后，我不免有些犹豫。
comment: A-1018.s1-P079; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 虽然最近的营业收入有所增加，但采购食材、支付日常开销，仍然需要留出不少资金。
comment: A-1018.s1-P080; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

comment: A-1018.s1-P081; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

comment: A-1018.s1-P082; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

comment: A-1018.s1-P083; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 好的，多谢您的介绍。
comment: A-1018.s1-P084; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

comment: A-1018.s1-P085; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

comment: A-1018.s1-P089; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 今天多谢招待。难得有这样一个悠闲的下午。
comment: A-1018.s1-P090; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 您太客气了。欢迎下次光临。
comment: A-1018.s1-P091; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 一定。也祝您的咖啡馆生意兴隆。
comment: A-1018.s1-P092; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我收起桌上的空杯，将碟子送回柜台。
comment: A-1018.s1-P095; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 窗外几位行人正围在报贩的摊子前，翻看当天的报纸。不远处的钟楼敲响了下午的钟声，街上的马车又陆续驶了过去。
comment: A-1018.s1-P096; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 我望了一眼记者方才坐过的位置。桌上除了几枚铜币，就只剩下一圈浅淡的杯痕。
comment: A-1018.s1-P097; 正文; text staging only, event disabled

text: 由于咖啡馆昨天举办了活动，客流量渐渐变大，我和阿黛尔的工作甚至可以用繁忙来形容。这样的热闹延续到了今天，直到中午时分人流量才减少，我们终于可以获得片刻的歇息了。

comment: church.1014.s2.P012; church.1014.s2.arrival; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「还不错。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P014; church.1014.s2.arrival; Text only, no event/route/result

comment: church.1014.s2.P015; church.1014.s2.arrival; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 不知道下午客流量怎么样，一旦忙起来就觉得时间过得飞快，不过这也意味着叔叔交给我的咖啡馆逐渐走上正途了。
comment: church.1014.s2.P018; church.1014.s2.notice_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

comment: church.1014.s2.P031; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「啊，好的，先生，您请问。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P032; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他对信没有任何反应，看来并不是神秘人那边派来的人
comment: church.1014.s2.P033; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 或许只是个普通工人吧
comment: church.1014.s2.P034; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「王城中，甚至圣徒街上都并不只有一家咖啡馆，但是它们有些并不向普通平民开放，而我看见各阶层的人民都可以自由进入你们的店中。您是出于怎样的考虑呢？」
comment: church.1014.s2.P035; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「只要能够赚钱就好，我们并不在乎客人的身份。我的叔叔杜瓦尔和前几任店长也是这样做的。将人划分三六九等是政治家的思想，却是和商人无关的。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P037; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「我只是想看见客人喝到我做的咖啡之后露出满意的笑容，这样就已经足够了，别的因素不是我要考虑的。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P038; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「我认为咖啡馆只面向部分人群开放本身就是错误的，其应当是面向普罗大众而存在的，不应以政治地位、经济实力等原因而将部分人拒之门外。我的叔叔杜瓦尔和前几任店长也是这样做的，我延续着他们的精神。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P039; church.1014.s2.letter_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「好的，我明白了。我之前是一名工人，生活在圣西尔万郊区，但是前段时间不幸在工作中受伤，成为了跛脚。唉，许多工厂都因为这点而排斥我。我近日一直为此感到烦忧，昨日听说圣徒街的沸点咖啡馆重新开业了，味道不错且面向大众开放，我实在感到好奇，所以今日特地前来。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P041; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 顺着他的话我不由得认真打量起面前这个男子
comment: church.1014.s2.P042; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 眼角周围有淡淡的皱纹，年纪并不小了，身上隐隐传来一阵烟味。或许是最近郁闷时常抽。
comment: church.1014.s2.P043; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 但是整体打理得很整齐，眼神也透露出坚毅，看起来是一个对自身和生活有一定追求的人。
comment: church.1014.s2.P044; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这实在是我们的荣幸，先生。希望这杯咖啡能让您感到些许慰藉。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P045; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「好的。店长，您听闻前几日埃利昂公爵和教会的人在旧城区和圣西尔万郊区救济贫民的事情了吗？」
comment: church.1014.s2.P046; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「有所耳闻。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P047; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「很高兴您有所了解。我那天就在被救济的队伍中，这是我最近感受过的最大的善意了，那粥虽然并不算得上十分美味，但足以饱腹了。虽然当下百姓的生活困难，没想到王庭和教会还是有一些有理想和良心的人为我们这些人而奔走着。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P048; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「很高兴得知这件事，我刚来到此地，没想到上层还有埃利昂公爵这样的人物。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P050; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「很高兴得知这件事，但是我相当怀疑王庭和教会中真的存在这样的人吗？」
comment: church.1014.s2.P051; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「很高兴得知这件事，希望百姓的生活能过得越来越好。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P052; church.1014.s2.relief_question; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「正是如此，店长。您不知道昨天的盛况……」
comment: church.1014.s2.P054; church.1014.s2.praise; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他突然眯着眼睛打量了我一下
comment: church.1014.s2.P057; church.1014.s2.doubt; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「店长，您不相信吗？埃利昂公爵他们施粥是实实在在发生的事。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P058; church.1014.s2.doubt; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我感到他的态度冷却了一些
comment: church.1014.s2.P059; church.1014.s2.doubt; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「不，先生，我相信这一点。我只是……算了，你当我未曾说过吧。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P060; church.1014.s2.doubt; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「好的，您不要紧张，我只是看见您觉得亲切，忍不住多聊了两句。我觉得王庭和教会并非全然糟糕透顶的……」
comment: church.1014.s2.P061; church.1014.s2.doubt; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他好像对我的回答并不满意，皱了皱眉
comment: church.1014.s2.P064; church.1014.s2.wish; Text only, no event/route/result
church.1014.s2.P065; church.1014.s2.wish; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他似乎还想说话，但此时新的客人走近了吧台
comment: church.1014.s2.P067; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「一不注意，竟然已经这个点了，我还需要去找找有没有我能盛任的工作。感谢您的咖啡，有机会我会再来拜访的。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P068; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「再见，先生！祝您能早日找到一个满意的工作。」
comment: church.1014.s2.P069; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他放下咖啡，站起来离开，这时我才发现他的左脚确实行走起来不太便利
comment: church.1014.s2.P070; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他的身影越来越远，随着咖啡馆的门一开一闭，我便再也看不见他的身影了
comment: church.1014.s2.P071; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 真是不容易
comment: church.1014.s2.P073; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我在心中叹口气
comment: church.1014.s2.P074; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 然后快速转换思绪，面对客人新的要求，开启了新的工作。
comment: church.1014.s2.P075; church.1014.s2.depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 今天咖啡店的生意也相当不错
comment: church.1020.s1.P003; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我正在为客人制作咖啡时，突然听见一阵嘈杂的脚步声
comment: church.1020.s1.P004; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 然后是阿黛尔同步响起的惊呼声
comment: church.1020.s1.P006; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「天呐，教会监察司的人？{playername}店长！{playername}店长！」
comment: church.1020.s1.P007; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我回过头，看见一群穿着统一制式服装的人
comment: church.1020.s1.P008; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「教会监察司」，刚才阿黛尔好像这样称呼着他们
comment: church.1020.s1.P009; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他们站定在咖啡馆中，其中一个看起来像领头的人则缓步站定在我面前
comment: church.1020.s1.P010; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我面前的客人惊慌失措地在我们之间来回转着，但是不敢有所动静
comment: church.1020.s1.P012; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「你就是{playername}，沸点咖啡馆的现任店长？」
comment: church.1020.s1.P013; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「是的。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P014; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「我们是教会监察司，今日奉命前来圣徒街搜查。我是今日负责带队的监察官，希望你能认真配合调查，不然的话——」
comment: church.1020.s1.P015; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他未说完，但配合着他凶狠的目光，在场的人都对这未尽的话心知肚明
comment: church.1020.s1.P016; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我的大脑急速运转着
comment: church.1020.s1.P017; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 教会监察司为什么会来圣徒街搜查？商铺经营不归监察司管吧？哦对了，好像听谁提过前几日街头有人散布修改「王选者」法律的消息……只有这个可能了。不过这和我也没什么大关系，随机应对即可吧。
comment: church.1020.s1.P018; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「好吧，但是能否请小心对待店中的客人和设备，我们还要继续营业的。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P020; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「我们咖啡馆正大光明，你们可以随意搜查。但是能否请小心对待店中的客人和设备，我们还要继续营业的。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P021; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「如果我不同意会怎么样呢？」
comment: church.1020.s1.P022; church.1020.s1.raid; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「哼，用不着你来指导工作。」「各人员注意，仔细搜查，不要放过任何一个角落。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P024; church.1020.s1.cooperate; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我们隔着吧台看着对方的眼睛对峙，谁也不肯服输，许久他先移开目光并缓慢开口
comment: church.1020.s1.P027; church.1020.s1.defy_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「哼，年轻人，我很欣赏你的勇气，但建议你要记得区分勇敢和鲁莽。」「今日是必定要开展检查的。各人员注意，仔细搜查，不要放过任何一个角落。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P028; church.1020.s1.defy_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我们隔着吧台看着对方的眼睛对峙，谁也不肯服输，最终我感到他身上的威严压过了我，我率先移开目光
comment: church.1020.s1.P030; church.1020.s1.defy_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「年轻人，我想你是刚来到圣诺特，还不太了解情况，我们的搜查不需要你的同意。」「现在碍于你的态度，我可能要采取一些特别措施了，来人。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P031; church.1020.s1.defy_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 两个穿着制式服装的人从两边走上前来，将我从吧台中推出来，一左一右地扣押着我
comment: church.1020.s1.P032; church.1020.s1.defy_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「现在可以配合检查了吧，店长。」「各人员注意，仔细搜查，不要放过任何一个角落。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P033; church.1020.s1.defy_fail; Text only, no event/route/result
church.1020.s1.P035; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他们四下分散开来，我看见他们的身影在大堂中忙碌着，甚至对顾客开展了简短的问询，部分顾客不堪其扰趁乱离开了。
comment: church.1020.s1.P036; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 唉，不知道会不会影响以后的生意。
comment: church.1020.s1.P037; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 突然想起神秘人给我留下的那封信好像被我顺手放在了吧台的抽屉中，密信他们看不懂应该不要紧……但是我该如何解释呢……
comment: church.1020.s1.P038; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 然而怕什么来什么。很快他们便搜查到了吧台区域，在我如鼓擂的心跳声中他们在抽屉中找到了那封信，并递交给了监察官。
comment: church.1020.s1.P039; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 监察官打开那封信看了看，然后走到我面前
comment: church.1020.s1.P040; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「解释一下吗，{playername}店长？这封信上写的是什么，告诉我。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P041; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这是我们内部每日记录进货、出账的账单，为了节省时间而简写为这种形式。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P044; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这不过我的一封私人信件，监察司奉命搜查商铺，可没有资格逼问一封私人信件写了什么。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P045; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「我想长官你们是来搜查与「王选者」法律相关的吧，这不过一封我的私人信件能有什么关系呢？」
comment: church.1020.s1.P046; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这不过是一封普通的私人信件，我看不出有什么被怀疑的必要。长官，您不会是早就对我有所怀疑吧？」
comment: church.1020.s1.P047; church.1020.s1.letter_found; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「账单？那你详细给我讲讲这个账单的构成。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P049; church.1020.s1.language_intro; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我快速回忆了一下信上的数字，然后不疾不徐地开口
comment: church.1020.s1.P051; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这些数字代表着店里咖啡豆、设备、餐具等物品的购买量、支出金额、每日消耗量、待购买量等数据，我叔叔当店长时就立下了这样的规矩，后面代代传承。」「这本来是我们的商业机密，但是长官你都发问了，我只能悉数奉告了。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P052; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 监察官边听着我的讲述边试图理解信上的数字
comment: church.1020.s1.P053; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「哼，听起来倒是有鼻子有眼。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P054; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他低头又看了一遍信纸，眉头紧皱，却没有从中找到能够反驳我的证据，他又盯着我看了片刻，最终将信纸递还给我。
comment: church.1020.s1.P055; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「暂时没有证据证明这封信与我们搜查的东西有关。收好你的东西。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P056; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我接过信纸，尽量平静地点了点头。
comment: church.1020.s1.P057; church.1020.s1.language_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我努力组织着语言，试图把信上的内容解释清楚，却发现自己越说越混乱。
comment: church.1020.s1.P059; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这……这是以前店里留下的账单记录方式，应该是采购……或者别的什么记录，具体内容我也不太清楚。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P060; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 监察官的表情逐渐变得严厉
comment: church.1020.s1.P061; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「你自己的店里发现的信，你却连内容都说不清楚？」
comment: church.1020.s1.P062; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我张了张嘴，一时找不到更合适的说辞。
comment: church.1020.s1.P063; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 监察官将信纸收了起来，冷冷地看着我。
comment: church.1020.s1.P064; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「你的解释前后矛盾。带走，等候进一步调查。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P065; church.1020.s1.language_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「私人信件？我看见的可是写着一串数字的不明信件。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P067; church.1020.s1.courage_intro; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我再次对上他探究的眼睛
comment: church.1020.s1.P068; church.1020.s1.courage_intro; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我毫不畏惧地直视着他，没有试图争抢那封信，也没有慌张，一字一句地说道
comment: church.1020.s1.P070; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「您可以搜查，也可以暂时扣下这封信。但在没有证据之前，请不要把无法解读的信件直接说成不法密信。这不过是前任店长给我留下的关于咖啡馆内部账单。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P071; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 咖啡馆内安静了下来，所有人都在看着我们
comment: church.1020.s1.P072; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我继续说道
comment: church.1020.s1.P073; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「如果您认为我有问题，可以按照教会的程序调查。我会配合，但不会承认自己没有做过的事。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P074; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 监察官的目光在我脸上停留了许久，像是在判断我究竟是虚张声势，还是确实问心无愧。
comment: church.1020.s1.P075; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 最终他冷哼一声，将信纸拍在桌上。
comment: church.1020.s1.P076; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「哼，没有证据，我们也不会仅凭一封无从解读的信抓人。收好你的信，但是如果之后我们发现有什么问题，你等着被传唤吧。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P077; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「我明白。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P078; church.1020.s1.courage_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我想要反驳，却被监察官凌厉的目光压得说不出话来。
comment: church.1020.s1.P080; church.1020.s1.courage_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这……这是前任店长给我留下的关于咖啡馆内部账单的信件……但是……我也不知道上面具体是什么意思……」

text: 我张张嘴又闭上，他充满威严与怀疑的目光刺痛了我，不敢再继续辩解

text: 监察官看着我的沉默，像是已经得出了自己的判断。

text: 「那正好，信带走，回去让我们监察司的人好好领会一下你所谓的「私人信件」。至于你，随我们走一趟。」

text: 「你倒是很清楚我们为何而来。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P088; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我指了指他手中的信纸
comment: church.1020.s1.P089; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「但这只是一封私人信件，是前任店长给我留下的之前店铺的账单，没有提到「王选者」，也没有任何与法律修改相关的内容，只不过是一串普通数字罢了。而且我听闻前几天是在民间宣扬「王选者」，如果对方采取这样隐晦的方式，并不能达到宣传的目的吧。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P090; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 监察官听闻多看了我两眼
comment: church.1020.s1.P091; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

comment: church.1020.s1.P092; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他又沉默了片刻，最终选择将信纸递给身旁的监察员，几名监察员低声讨论后也无法确认其中有什么异常。
comment: church.1020.s1.P093; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「信你收好。至于你，继续留在店里接受调查，不得擅自离开圣徒街。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P094; church.1020.s1.wisdom_pass; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「你倒是很清楚我们为何而来。」
comment: church.1020.s1.P096; church.1020.s1.wisdom_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我试图继续说出一些合理而又道理的理由来摆脱嫌疑，但脑中一片混乱，只能勉强找出几个听起来合理的词。
comment: church.1020.s1.P097; church.1020.s1.wisdom_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「这封信……是我与前任店长沟通的私人信件……上面写的东西应该是店铺内部经营状况，可能就是之前他们订购咖啡豆和机器设备的开销……没什么重要的。怎么看都与你们要查的东西无关吧……」
comment: church.1020.s1.P098; church.1020.s1.wisdom_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 话一出口，我便意识到自己的解释漏洞百出。
comment: church.1020.s1.P099; church.1020.s1.wisdom_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 「可能？应该？{playername}店长，你连自己要解释什么都不知道。」

text: 我试图继续补充，却只能让事情变得更加糟糕。

text: 「你的说辞无法令人信服。」「先把人带走，信件作为证物收存。」

comment: church.1020.s1.P117; church.1020.s1.perception_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

comment: church.1020.s1.P118; church.1020.s1.perception_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

comment: church.1020.s1.P119; church.1020.s1.perception_fail; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我现在感到一丝后怕，如果刚才没有应对得当，现在的我是会被他们带走审问吗？

text: 不过，我当然没有理由拒绝。
comment: church.1023.s1.P063; church.1023.s1.rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我看了看那张文件。
comment: church.1023.s1.P065; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 上面的印章和其他文书没有什么区别。
comment: church.1023.s1.P066; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 不过，在旁边的登记簿上，我的名字似乎被人重新填写过一次。
comment: church.1023.s1.P067; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 原本的字迹已经被墨水覆盖，又用另一种笔迹写上了新的处理结果。
comment: church.1023.s1.P068; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 而且，记录上标注的释放时间，似乎比我刚刚被带回牢房的时间还要早。
comment: church.1023.s1.P069; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result
church.1023.s1.P070; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 有人修改了我的拘押记录？
comment: church.1023.s1.P071; church.1023.s1.record_notice; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈请问，是谁批准释放我的？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P073; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈登记上写得很清楚，按照规定处理的。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P074; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈我是说，刚刚是谁来办理手续的？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P075; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈我哪知道？今天送过来的文件这么多。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P076; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈话怎么这么多？再问我就和上面说你不服命令，重新把你关进去。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P077; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result
church.1023.s1.P078; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 算了。
comment: church.1023.s1.P079; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 不管究竟是谁帮了我，现在最重要的事情，还是赶紧离开这个地方。
comment: church.1023.s1.P080; church.1023.s1.rescue_depart; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈我回来了！⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P088; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈……{playername}？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P089; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 她愣了一下，随即快步走来。
comment: church.1023.s1.P090; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈你终于回来了！⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P091; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈他们没有对你怎么样吧？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P092; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈没有没有，只是被关了几天。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P093; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈这还叫没什么！我去问了好几次，他们都不肯告诉我什么时候放你回来。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P094; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈抱歉，让你担心了。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P095; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈……回来就好。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P096; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 她替我拉开椅子。
comment: church.1023.s1.P097; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈不过，他们怎么突然愿意放人了？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P098; church.1023.s1.home; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈他们本来也没找到犯罪证据，我和监察官讲了讲道理，就把我放了。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P101; church.1023.s1.home_persuade; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈那真是太好了，至少教会的人还愿意讲道理。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P102; church.1023.s1.home_persuade; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈不过，既然他们已经盯上了咖啡馆，以后还是得小心。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P103; church.1023.s1.home_persuade; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈花了点钱，总算让他们同意放人了。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P105; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈花钱？你是说……⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P106; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈嘘！别说出来。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P107; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈这些人真是……⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P108; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 她叹了口气。
comment: church.1023.s1.P109; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈你一会让把钱筹一下送过去。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P110; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈我才不做这种事情呢！⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P111; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈那行，一会儿我去干这脏活累活吧......⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P112; church.1023.s1.home_bribe; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈说实话，我也不知道。他们本来还要继续调查，结果突然有人送来文件，说我可以走了。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P114; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈突然有人送来文件？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P115; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈是啊，连看守都不知道怎么回事。真奇怪。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P116; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 阿黛尔似乎想到了什么，沉默了一会儿。
comment: church.1023.s1.P117; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result
church.1023.s1.P118; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈你知道些什么？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P119; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈啊？没有，我也只是猜测……⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P120; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈猜测什么？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P121; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈以前杜瓦尔先生经营咖啡馆的时候，认识不少人。有些人虽然不方便公开露面，但很重视这家店。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P122; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈如果他们知道你被教会带走了，或许不会坐视不管。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P123; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈你是说，有人暗中帮了我？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P124; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈只是猜测而已，我也不确定。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P125; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 她低头整理起桌上的餐具，似乎不打算继续这个话题。
comment: church.1023.s1.P126; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈不过，如果真是他们……看来那些人还没有忘记这里。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P127; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈那些人？⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P128; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈没什么。你才刚回来，先休息吧。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P129; church.1023.s1.home_rescue; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈总之，欢迎回来，店长先生。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P131; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: ⌈嗯，我回来了。⌋
comment: church.1023.s1.P132; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我靠在椅背上，终于松了口气。
comment: church.1023.s1.P133; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 咖啡馆似乎什么都没有改变。
comment: church.1023.s1.P134; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 不过我的心态已经完全不同，
comment: church.1023.s1.P135; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 在监牢里度过的三天却让我后背发凉。
comment: church.1023.s1.P136; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我这次能因信的的事情被抓进去，下一次又会因为什么遭遇不测。
comment: church.1023.s1.P137; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 三天前，教会监察司的人突然闯进咖啡馆，将我带走。
comment: church.1023.s1.P138; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 三天后，我终于回到了这里。
comment: church.1023.s1.P139; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 但那几封密文仍然被扣押在教会手中。
comment: church.1023.s1.P140; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 而且，在离开看守所之前，他们还专门提醒我：
comment: church.1023.s1.P141; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 如果发现有关乱党的情报，必须向教会报告。
comment: church.1023.s1.P142; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result
church.1023.s1.P143; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 这算什么意思？
comment: church.1023.s1.P144; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 今后要是那个神秘人再给我送来几封信，难道我还得主动跑去监察司告诉他们？
comment: church.1023.s1.P145; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 开什么玩笑。
comment: church.1023.s1.P146; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 可是，如果不这么做……
comment: church.1023.s1.P147; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我抬起头，看向正在厨房里忙碌的阿黛尔。
comment: church.1023.s1.P148; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 自从来到这家店，怪事就一个接着一个。
comment: church.1023.s1.P149; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 王都圣诺特的漩涡下面究竟有多少骇人的存在？它们在谋划些什么？为什么我会被卷到这些事情里？我还能保护我和身边的人吗？
comment: church.1023.s1.P150; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 三日关押积累下来的疲惫与巨大的思考量冲撞着我的思绪，
comment: church.1023.s1.P151; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我再也无力去支撑精神，倒在座椅上睡去......
comment: church.1023.s1.P152; church.1023.s1.home_end; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 距离上次与监察官会面又过了不知多少天
comment: church.1023.s2.P005; church.1023.s2.prison; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 这段日子里我尝试与外界联系，却都失败了
comment: church.1023.s2.P006; church.1023.s2.prison; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我所能接触到的只有这四方墙壁
comment: church.1023.s2.P007; church.1023.s2.prison; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 不知道今日是何日，不知道咖啡馆怎么样了，不知道阿黛尔怎么样了，不知道我离开之后神秘人是否还在接触咖啡馆……
comment: church.1023.s2.P008; church.1023.s2.prison; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 不知道……不知道……什么都不知道……
comment: church.1023.s2.P009; church.1023.s2.prison; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我的意识在这种日子中渐渐模糊……
comment: church.1023.s2.P010; church.1023.s2.prison; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 沉寂和单调，是我牢狱生活的全部
comment: church.1023.s2.P013; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 直到某一天我的世界出现了新的声音
comment: church.1023.s2.P014; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 那是几个穿着制服的人，走进了关押我的房间内
comment: church.1023.s2.P016; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 他们对着我说了一串话
comment: church.1023.s2.P017; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 但由于脱离外界太久，意识模糊，我只能隐隐约约辨认出几个词，什么「革命」 「镇压」 「清算」……
comment: church.1023.s2.P018; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 在我还未能理解这些词句的意思时
comment: church.1023.s2.P019; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我感到我被他们强行从地上拉了起来，被推动着向外走
comment: church.1023.s2.P020; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 方墙以外的世界
comment: church.1023.s2.P021; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 新鲜的空气
comment: church.1023.s2.P022; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 曾经我渴求无数次的东西就这样呈现在我面前
comment: church.1023.s2.P023; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 现下我却无暇顾及
comment: church.1023.s2.P024; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我不知道我会被他们带往哪里
comment: church.1023.s2.P025; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 就这样走着，走着……
comment: church.1023.s2.P026; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 这里是哪里？
comment: church.1023.s2.P027; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 刑场？
comment: church.1023.s2.P028; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 我要死了吗？
comment: church.1023.s2.P029; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 为什么？
comment: church.1023.s2.P030; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 为什么？为什么？为什么？为什么？为什么？
comment: church.1023.s2.P031; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result

text: 带着这样的想法，我迎来了人生的终点。
comment: church.1023.s2.P032; church.1023.s2.execution; Text only, no event/route/result
